# homarr_board_add_item (Action)

Adds a widget or app tile to a Homarr board, through `POST /api/boards/items`.

This is a Terraform *action*, not a resource, and needs **Terraform 1.14 or newer**. It runs only when invoked — from a resource's `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` or with `terraform apply -invoke=action.homarr_board_add_item.<name>` — and remembers nothing afterwards. Homarr places the tile at the first free cell of the board's main section, in every layout including the mobile one, and returns only the new tile's id, which the action logs. With `layout_id`, `x` and `y` the action then moves the tile to that position in that one layout — in practice the board's desktop layout, through `homarr_board`'s `base_layout_id` — and the other layouts keep the automatic position.

~> **Not idempotent.** Every invocation adds another tile. Trigger it on `after_create` of the resource the tile belongs to, never on `after_update`, and expect a duplicate tile from every `-invoke`.

~> **Terraform cannot see, change or remove the tile afterwards.** No REST call reads a board's tiles or deletes a single one, so a tile added here is not in state, is not removed on destroy, and must be edited or deleted in the Homarr UI. Destroying the board removes its tiles with it.

Further caveats, all imposed by Homarr's API:

* App tiles reference the app by id, in `options_json = jsonencode({ appId = homarr_app.x.id })`. Homarr does not clean tiles up when an app is deleted, so destroying or replacing the `homarr_app` leaves a tile pointing at nothing.
* Widgets that need an integration are refused without `integration_ids` (`<kind> requires an integration`), and integrations have no REST API to list them: the id has to be copied from the address bar of the integration's edit page in the UI. In practice the action suits integration-free kinds such as `app`, `bookmarks`, `notebook`, `clock` and `iframe`.
* Homarr stores `options_json` as given and validates hardly any of it, so a misspelt option silently yields a tile with that option at its default. Option names belong to each widget and change between Homarr releases.
* The API key needs modify access to the board, use access to every listed integration, and an admin for custom widgets. A board without a free cell is refused (`Board section is full`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Actions need Terraform 1.14 or newer. The action keeps no state: every
# invocation adds another tile, and Terraform never removes it again.
resource "homarr_board" "infra" {
  name         = "infra"
  column_count = 12
}

resource "homarr_app" "grafana" {
  name     = "Grafana"
  icon_url = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons@master/svg/grafana.svg"
  href     = "https://grafana.example.com"

  # Place a tile for the app once, when the app is created. The action reads the
  # app's id, so it has to run after_create; before_create would be a cycle.
  # Destroying the app later leaves the tile behind, pointing at nothing.
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.homarr_board_add_item.grafana]
    }
  }
}

action "homarr_board_add_item" "grafana" {
  config {
    board_id     = homarr_board.infra.id
    kind         = "app"
    options_json = jsonencode({ appId = homarr_app.grafana.id })
    width        = 2
    height       = 1

    # Optional: move the tile to column 4 of the top row on the desktop layout.
    # The mobile layout keeps the position Homarr picked. base_layout_id is
    # known only for boards this provider created, not for imports or copies.
    layout_id = homarr_board.infra.base_layout_id
    x         = 4
    y         = 0
  }
}

# Widgets without an integration work the same way; this one can be added on
# demand with: terraform apply -invoke=action.homarr_board_add_item.clock
action "homarr_board_add_item" "clock" {
  config {
    board_id     = homarr_board.infra.id
    kind         = "clock"
    options_json = jsonencode({ is24HourFormat = true })
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `board_id` (String) Identifier of the board to add the tile to.
- `kind` (String) Widget kind, as Homarr names it: for example `app`, `bookmarks`, `notebook`, `clock`, `iframe` or `weather`. The set of kinds grows with each Homarr release, so it is checked by Homarr rather than here.

### Optional

- `height` (Number) Height of the tile in grid rows, between 1 and 24. Set together with `width`.
- `integration_ids` (List of String) Identifiers of the integrations the widget reads from, at most 32. Required by Homarr for widgets that only work with an integration.
- `layout_id` (String) Identifier of the layout in which to move the tile to `x` and `y`, through `PATCH /api/boards/{boardId}/items/{itemId}/layouts/{layoutId}`. Set it to `homarr_board.<name>.base_layout_id`, the board's desktop layout: that is the only layout id any REST response contains. It is null for a board that was imported or created before provider 0.3.0, and `homarr_board_copy` has none at all. Tiles on such boards can only take Homarr's automatic position: leave `layout_id`, `x` and `y` out for them, since the action fails when `x` and `y` are set while `layout_id` is null. Set together with `x` and `y`.
- `options_json` (String) The widget's options as a JSON object, typically built with `jsonencode`. Options left out take the widget's defaults. Defaults to `{}`.
- `width` (Number) Width of the tile in grid columns, between 1 and 24. Homarr narrows it to fit each layout, such as the 3-column mobile layout. Set together with `height`; leave both out for the widget's default size.
- `x` (Number) Column of the tile's left edge in `layout_id`, counted from 0. The tile has to fit: `x + width` must not exceed the columns of the board's main area — `column_count` for a board made by `homarr_board`, less any side columns set up in the UI. Homarr refuses a position that overlaps another tile. Needs `layout_id`, `y`, `width` and `height`.
- `y` (Number) Row of the tile's top edge in `layout_id`, counted from 0. Set together with `x`.
